sources.snippet: Perplexity is the primary metric used to evaluate the quality of text generated by language models, as emphasized in NVIDIA's Generative AI and LLMs course. Perplexity measures how well a language model predicts a sequence of tokens, with lower values indicating better performance, as the model is less ''surprised'' by the data.

sources.title: Introducing ChatGPT - OpenAI
sources.snippet: Methods We trained this model using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), using the same methods as InstructGPT ⁠, but with slight differences in the data collection setup. We trained an initial model using supervised fine-tuning: human AI trainers provided conversations in which they played both sides—the user and an AI assistant.
